Ravens vs Falcons DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, October 11 · NFL Week 5 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 9, 8:17 PM ET

Bijan Robinson has the highest SPAGS projection in the Ravens at Falcons DraftKings Showdown: 21.1 points at $11,800 FLEX, 31.6 at captain for $17,700. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Robinson is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 9.6 points at an $11,800 FLEX salary, in a game with a 43.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 25.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Robinson at captain. Drake London is the next captain in line, at 15.5%. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 20.9 routes.

Atlanta is a 3.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.5 for the Falcons and 20 for the Ravens.

Behind Robinson and London, the next projections are Tyler Huntley (16.7, $8,800), Michael Penix Jr. (15.5, $9,400) and Derrick Henry (14.7, $11,000).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 9, 8:17 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 25.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 21.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 31.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 18.5 carries and 4.3 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 21.0 points with a simulated floor of 9.6 and a ceiling of 37.8. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 25.3% as the captain and 46.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Drake London, ATL WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Drake London holds 15.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 16.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 20.9 routes. Across 10,000 simulations London averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 5.4 and a ceiling of 36.7. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.5% as the captain and 37.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Tyler Huntley, BAL QB ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Tyler Huntley holds 11.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 16.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.0 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Huntley averaged 16.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 29.7. He holds 64% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.2% as the captain and 53.2% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Ravens vs Falcons

Michael Penix Jr., ATL QB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Michael Penix Jr. carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.5 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Penix averaged 15.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.2 and a ceiling of 28.5. He holds 56% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.5% as the captain and 49.9% in a FLEX spot.

Derrick Henry, BAL RB ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Derrick Henry carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 14.7 DraftKings points for an $11,000 FLEX salary ($16,500 at captain). The model gives him 20.3 carries and 1.6 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Henry averaged 14.8 points with a simulated floor of 5.3 and a ceiling of 29.0. He holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.2% as the captain and 36.0% in a FLEX spot.

Zay Flowers carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 14.5 DraftKings points for a $10,000 FLEX salary ($15,000 at captain). The model gives him 5.7 targets on 16.5 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Flowers averaged 14.5 points with a simulated floor of 3.5 and a ceiling of 35.0. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.9% as the captain and 30.1% in a FLEX spot.

Mark Andrews, BAL TE ($6,400 FLEX / $9,600 CPT)

Mark Andrews carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.6 DraftKings points for a $6,400 FLEX salary ($9,600 at captain). The model gives him 5.6 targets on 18.5 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Andrews averaged 9.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.6 and a ceiling of 25.3. He holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.6% as the captain and 24.0% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Olamide Zaccheaus, ATL WR ($2,400 FLEX / $3,600 CPT)

Olamide Zaccheaus projects for 4.0 DraftKings points at a $2,400 FLEX salary, 1.67 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.4 targets on 10.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Zaccheaus averaged 4.0 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 13.7. He holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.0% as the captain and 11.2% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Justice Hill, BAL RB ($3,200 FLEX / $4,800 CPT)

Justice Hill projects for 5.3 DraftKings points at a $3,200 FLEX salary, 1.67 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 3.1 carries and 2.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Hill averaged 5.3 points with a simulated floor of 0.8 and a ceiling of 12.4. He holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.7% as the captain and 12.8% in a FLEX spot.

Who is the best captain for the Ravens vs Falcons DraftKings Showdown?

Bijan Robinson holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 25.3%, ahead of Drake London (15.5%) and Tyler Huntley (11.2%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Ravens vs Falcons?

Build around Mark Andrews at captain with Bijan Robinson, Drake London and Tyler Huntley at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (19 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $10,000 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Ravens vs Falcons DraftKings Showdown?

Bijan Robinson leads the SPAGS model at 21.1 DraftKings points for $11,800 at FLEX, or 31.6 points at captain for $17,700.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Ravens vs Falcons Showdown?

Bijan Robinson is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 28 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Ravens vs Falcons DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Olamide Zaccheaus (4.0 points at $2,400), Justice Hill (5.3 points at $3,200) and Jahan Dotson (5.7 points at $3,600).

What is the Ravens vs Falcons spread and total?

The Falcons are a 3.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 43.5, with implied team totals of 23.5 for the Falcons and 20 for the Ravens.
